parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end of the time range for the query, specified as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

parameters.name: EventBusName
parameters.description: The name of the event bus.

parameters.name: EventSource
parameters.description: The name of the event source.

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return per page. Use this parameter with NextToken to paginate the results.><notice>The maximum value is 100.></notice>

parameters.name: MatchedRule
parameters.description: The name of the matched rule.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token for retrieving the next page of results. It is returned in the response to a previous request if more results are available.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range for the query, specified as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.
